meanings.en: the window at the front of a vehicle
meanings.exampleEn: The rain made it hard to see through the windscreen.

meanings.en: the sport of riding on water on a board with a sail
meanings.exampleEn: We tried windsurfing on our holiday by the sea.
meanings.exampleTr: Deniz kenarındaki tatilimizde rüzgar sörfü denedik.

meanings.en: the part of a bird, insect, or plane used for flying
meanings.exampleEn: The bird spread its wings and flew away.
meanings.exampleTr: Kuş kanatlarını açtı ve uçup gitti.

meanings.en: a thin piece of metal used to carry electricity or to make fences
meanings.exampleEn: He connected the speakers with a long wire.

meanings.en: to become dry and start to die, especially of a plant
meanings.exampleEn: The flowers will wither without water.

meanings.en: a man with magic powers in stories
meanings.exampleEn: The young wizard cast a powerful spell.
meanings.exampleTr: Genç büyücü güçlü bir büyü yaptı.

meanings.en: a feeling of surprise and admiration, or something that causes it
meanings.exampleEn: The children stared at the fireworks in wonder.

meanings.en: having a job, or relating to work or operating properly
meanings.exampleEn: She has long working hours at the hospital.

meanings.en: a period of physical exercise
meanings.exampleEn: I do a workout at the gym every morning.
meanings.exampleTr: Her sabah spor salonunda antrenman yaparım.

meanings.en: the place where someone works
meanings.exampleEn: Safety is very important in the workplace.

meanings.en: a room or building where things are made or repaired, or a meeting for practical training
meanings.exampleEn: We attended a writing workshop last weekend.
meanings.exampleTr: Geçen hafta sonu bir yazma çalıştayına katıldık.

meanings.en: damaged or thin because of long use
meanings.exampleEn: His old shoes were worn and full of holes.
meanings.exampleTr: Eski ayakkabıları yıpranmış ve delik doluydu.

meanings.en: having a particular value, or good enough to deserve something
meanings.exampleEn: This painting is worth a lot of money.

meanings.en: useful, important, or good enough to be worth the effort
meanings.exampleEn: Volunteering is a worthwhile way to spend your time.
meanings.exampleTr: Gönüllü olmak zamanını geçirmenin zahmete değer bir yoludur.

meanings.en: deserving respect, attention, or support
meanings.exampleEn: The charity is a worthy cause that helps children.
meanings.exampleTr: Bu hayır kurumu çocuklara yardım eden, desteği hak eden bir davadır.

meanings.en: an injury to the body, especially a cut in the skin
meanings.exampleEn: The nurse cleaned the wound on his arm.

meanings.en: a type of food made by rolling a filling in thin bread, or a covering
meanings.exampleEn: I bought a chicken wrap for lunch.
meanings.exampleTr: Öğle yemeği için bir tavuklu dürüm aldım.

meanings.en: paper or material used to cover or pack something
meanings.exampleEn: She removed the wrapping from the gift carefully.

meanings.en: the joint between the hand and the arm
meanings.exampleEn: She wears a bracelet on her wrist.

meanings.en: a watch worn on the wrist
meanings.exampleEn: He checked the time on his wristwatch.

meanings.en: expressed in writing rather than spoken
meanings.exampleEn: You must provide written permission to take part.
meanings.exampleTr: Katılmak için yazılı izin vermeniz gerekir.

meanings.en: a loud, sharp cry or shout
meanings.exampleEn: She gave a yell when she saw the spider.

meanings.en: a set of exercises for the body and mind to relax and stay healthy
meanings.exampleEn: She practises yoga every morning to relax.
meanings.exampleTr: Rahatlamak için her sabah yoga yapar.
